description_en: Creates a service-linked role for Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC). A service-linked role is required for you to use E-HPC
description_zh: 创建EHPC的服务关联角色（首次使用必须）
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc initialize-ehpc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-name E-HPC --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InitializeEHPC

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the service-linked role is created.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html operation to obtain the IDs of regions supported by E-HPC
parameters.help_zh:
创建服务关联角色的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html接口查询E-HPC支持的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the service for which you must create a service-linked role. Valid values:

E-HPC: You must create the AliyunServiceRoleForEHPC service-linked role.
E-HPC Instant: You must create the AliyunServiceRoleForEHPCManagedNetwork service-linked role.

This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.help_zh:
要使用的服务名称，需要创建对应的服务关联角色。取值范围：

E-HPC：表示创建AliyunServiceRoleForEHPC。
E-HPC Instant：表示创建AliyunServiceRoleForEHPCManagedNetwork。

该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: service_name
